LIVE_PATH_PREFLIGHT.note: Requires FG_LIVE_PROOF=1 and FG_PREFLIGHT_TENANT_ID to execute

IDENTITY_CONFIGURATION.reason: Auth0 organization creation for an ephemeral proof tenant requires Auth0 Management API credentials configured in admin_gateway. No POST /identity/tenants/{tenant_id}/configure endpoint exists in admin_gateway/routers/identity.py (confirmed 2026-09-01). This step is a production operator action performed outside this harness.
manual_steps: 1. In Auth0 Dashboard → Organizations → Create organization named '{tenant_id}'
2. Enable the FrostGate Auth0 application on the organization
3. Configure tenant_id metadata on the Auth0 organization
4. Verify identity_policy record exists in admin_gateway DB for tenant

OPERATIONAL_READINESS.note: operational=True requires bound admin identity (OIDC flow). Requires IDENTITY_CONFIGURATION manual step to complete.

CLIENT_ADMIN_AUTHENTICATION.reason: Client admin OIDC browser login cannot be automated by this harness. Auth0 org-level OIDC flow requires a real browser session.
manual_steps: 1. Visit the invitation_url from bootstrap response
2. Sign in with jcosat0211@gmail.com via Auth0 Google OAuth flow
3. Complete Auth0 organization login for the proof tenant
5. Re-fetch lifecycle: operational=True expected after binding

TENANT_ISOLATION.note: Full cross-tenant 403 denial from a tenant-scoped identity proven by CLIENT-E2E-001 scenario 2.

CANONICAL_AUTHZ_INDEPENDENT.note: Canonical lifecycle reflects revocation from DB state without waiting for Auth0 convergence.

PROJECTION_CONVERGENCE.reason: identity_projection_outbox query requires direct DB access — no public HTTP endpoint. For the proof admin, identity_binding_status=unbound means NO projection event is generated. Auth0 projection delivery proven by AUTH-ROLE-001C.

manual_proof_items: IDENTITY_CONFIGURATION: Auth0 org creation is a platform-operator action; no automated API endpoint available in this harness.
CLIENT_ADMIN_AUTHENTICATION: OIDC browser login for proof tenant admin cannot be automated; requires manual Auth0 org OIDC flow completion.
not_proven_items: PROJECTION_CONVERGENCE via HTTP: outbox table has no public query endpoint. Proven separately by AUTH-ROLE-001C production artifact.
